slides.headline: August 5, 2013 was his return and suspension day
slides.body: Rodriguez returned to the Yankees on August 5, 2013. MLB announced the same day that he would be suspended, pending appeal, through the 2014 season.

slides.headline: MLB linked the suspension to Biogenesis
slides.body: The suspension came from his role in the Biogenesis scandal. He was returning while MLB was investigating his possible connection to performance-enhancing drugs.

slides.headline: The penalty was later reduced to 162 games
slides.body: After an arbitration hearing, the suspension was reduced from 211 games to 162 games. That kept him off the field for the entire 2014 season.
